Each hit in a single player game will affect the player's [[rating]].
If it goes below -2000, he will be considered an enemy, and be attacked by all units.

The breakdown of rating changes for killing enemy or friendly units are listed below:

{| class=wikitable
|'''Object'''||'''Enemy'''||'''Friendly'''
|-
|Urals, UAZ, BRDM2, BMP, HMMVW, LandRover, Stryker, M113, Camel, RHIB||align="right"|200||align="right"|-1400
|-
|Soldier||align="right"|200||align="right"|-1400
|-
|Sniper, Especas, Saboteur||align="right"|500||align="right"|-3500
|-
|Officer, Squad/Team Leader||align="right"|1000||align="right"|-3500
|-
|M1Abrams, Vulcan, T72, Shilka, Cobra, Black Hawk, Little Bird, Harrier, A10, KA50, Mi17, Su34||align="right"|1000||align="right"|-7000
|-
|Civilian, Ural Civil, Bus, Tractor, Hilux||align="right"|-||align="right"|-400
|-
|Civilian Cars, Motorcycle||align="right"|-||align="right"|0
|}

== Ratings and Ranks ==
When a unit is assigned a specific [[rank]] (either when placed in the editor, or via the [[setUnitRank]] command), it will automatically receive a certain rating level (even if the unit's previous rating was higher than the new level).

|'''Rank'''||'''Rating'''
|-
|PRIVATE||align="right"|0
|-
|CORPORAL||align="right"|500
|-
|SERGEANT||align="right"|1500
|-
|LIEUTENANT||align="right"|2500
|-
|CAPTAIN||align="right"|3500
|-
|MAJOR||align="right"|5000
|-
|COLONEL||align="right"|7500 
|}
